name: dumbbell single leg step up
description: Stepping up onto a bench with one leg while holding dumbbells. It builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a box or bench.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel to stand up tall.
Lower back down under control without bouncing off the floor foot.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
